verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs include a dedicated 'Client SDKs' section and 'Send your first event' getting-started material, so official SDKs exist to build against. Community discussion of apps sending their traffic to mParticle loosely corroborates app-side SDK integration. However, the evidence is mostly section titles with no detail on languages or platforms, SDK depth, or AI-native ergonomics. Missing for 10: platform and language coverage of the SDKs, substantive SDK reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, AI or agent-oriented developer tooling.
